meta.title: SAP MM (Purchase Requisition): PR created in SAP → pulled into Procol
gaps: Configure the SAP MM bidirectional integration and its RFC/API key parameters
Create a purchase requisition in SAP
Trigger or observe the SAP-to-Procol synchronization
Compare PR number, line items, GL code, cost centre, plant, vendor, amount, and currency between SAP and Procol
Verify that no integration error was recorded
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the SAP MM bidirectional integration and its RFC/API key parameters; Create a purchase requisition in SAP; Trigger or observe the SAP-to-Procol synchronization; Compare PR number, line items, GL code, cost centre, plant, vendor, amount, and currency between SAP and Procol; Verify that no integration error was recorded

args.need: configure the SAP MM integration, create the SAP purchase requisition, trigger or wait for synchronization, compare all listed PR fields between SAP and Procol, and verify that no integration error was recorded

steps.note: These cross-system setup, trigger, comparison, and integration-log checks are not available in the catalog.
Open Procol's purchase requisition area to provide the closest in-product observation after the tester completes the external sync.
Show open requisitions, where a synchronized SAP requisition would be expected to appear.
Assert that Procol displays at least one open purchase requisition after the attempted synchronization.
